messages:
maria: Quick topic toss-up for Aug webinar: 'Quantization vs Batching: Practical Cost & Latency Tradeoffs' — aim for engineering + platform PM audience. Want live numbers, a short demo, and clear takeaways. Who can own?
alex: Love this. We can show real perf curves: int8 quantized model vs batching on same GPU. Priya can show inference graph.
priya: I can present on quantization profiles and degradation cases (5-7min). Need representative model + eval prompts.
jordan: I'll pull a customer example that used batching + small-quantization and share before/after TCO. Can do a 6-minute case study.
sam: Creative notes: need a hero visual comparing latency vs cost, and a 20s promo. Please submit final speaker headshots by 8/2.
lee: Ops: studio available Mon 8/17 or Wed 8/19. Which is better for rehearsals? calendar-bot: Tentative slots added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1812349999
emily: Sales ask: include a lead-tag checkbox for "interested in quantization/optimization services" so we can route follow-ups.
maria: Proposed format: 35m main + 25m Q&A + a 15m optional post-webinar office hours. Run-of-show draft: 
```
00:00-00:04 - Welcome + goals + poll (maria)
00:04-00:14 - Quantization 101 + quality tradeoffs (priya)
00:14-00:24 - Batching patterns & batching demo (alex)
00:24-00:30 - Customer case: TCO lift & lessons (jordan)
00:30-00:35 - Decision matrix: when to quantize vs batch (maria + panel)
00:35-01:00 - Live Q&A + office-hours sign-up (all)
```
Keep demos short: 3-5 minutes each with pre-recorded fallbacks in case demo flaps.
alex: I'll prepare a 4-step demo harness that toggles quantization and batch size locally. Priya, can you validate output quality thresholds for the demo?
priya: Yes. I'll prepare a slide with perceptual quality checks and automated eval metrics to use during the demo.
jordan: I'll redact customer numbers but include percentage improvements and a one-line quote.
sam: Slide deadlines: first-pass deck by 8/5, final by 8/12. Promo clip ready by 8/9. Brand review slot request for 8/10.
lee: Locking studio for Wed 8/19 10:00 PT for final recording and dress rehearsal. calendar-bot: Event updated -> Wed 2026-08-19 10:00 PT
emily: Sales routing note: add form field "Current inference monthly spend (optional)" so we can prioritize demos. Will that impact reg flow?
sam: We can add that to the registration form. We'll tag and pass to Sales queue B.
maria: Action list: Priya -> 60-90 word abstract + 3 takeaways by Tue 7/28; Alex -> demo harness + scripts by 8/2; Jordan -> case slides + quote by 8/4; Sam -> promo + landing copy by 8/5; Lee -> calendar + studio. Please mark rehearsal availability in the doc.
alex: Demo script uploaded. Will include a pre-recorded fallback clip in case real-time toggles hiccup.
priya: Abstract dropped in the doc.
jordan: Case draft uploaded, redacted numbers in place.
sam: Registered brand review for 8/10.
maria: Finalizing title: "Quantization vs Batching: Practical Cost & Latency Tradeoffs for Inference". Locking topic unless objections in 3 hours. Thanks team!
